targets.claim: Indiana summers are long, warm, humid, and wet.
Indiana winters are chilly and windy.
Indiana is partly cloudy year round.
The temperature range in Indiana typically varies from 22°F to 85°F.
The temperature is rarely below 3°F or above 92°F.
The wettest year recorded at Indianapolis was 57.65 inches in 1876.
The driest year recorded at Indianapolis was 24.97 inches in 1934.
The most snowfall recorded was 74.5 inches in one season in 1979 at Rockford.
